sentences.en: The little-known fact is that tea was first discovered in China.
sentences.zh: 一个鲜为人知的事实是中国首先发现了茶。

sentences.en: Many people have never heard of the little-known town, but it's actually quite beautiful.
sentences.zh: 很多人从未听说过这个鲜为人知的小镇，但它其实非常美丽。

sentences.en: The company has a little-known product line that sells eco-friendly cleaning supplies.
sentences.zh: 这家公司有一个鲜为人知的产品线，专门销售环保清洁用品。
